# Search shows typed HTML as plain text, not markup

<!-- compiled by gremlin from .gremlin/flows/adversarial/search-shows-typed-html-as-plain-text-not-markup.md (cd79f235d03149e1). Edit the flow, not this file. -->

## Step 1: Type <s>mug</s> into the Search box
Start on http://localhost:4000/. Type "<s>mug</s>" into the Search box.

## Step 2: Click Search
Click "Search".

## Check the expected outcome
Verify that the results heading shows the text <s>mug</s> literally, with the angle brackets visible.
Verify that no text in the results heading is struck through.

kane.reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the results heading shows the text <s>mug</s> literally, with the angle brackets visible"
kane.oneLiner: The results heading interpreted the search text as formatting instead of showing the characters the user entered.

verdict.title: Search heading renders query markup as HTML
verdict.oneLiner: The results heading interpreted the search text as formatting instead of showing the characters the user entered.
verdict.rootCause: The page treated the submitted text `<s>mug</s>` as HTML. As a result, the angle brackets disappeared and “mug” was displayed with a line through it rather than as literal text.
verdict.suggestion: Escape search-query text before placing it in the results heading, then add a regression test for HTML-like queries such as `<s>mug</s>`.
